title: Fight camera · leaning it with the right stick
description: In a fight the right stick leans the camera a little round the fight (up to 25° either side, 10° up or down), and it eases back when let go (src/game.ts `rightStick`). The stick is a fake standard pad set from the page.

steps.eval: window.stick = (x, y) => { const pad = { connected: true, mapping: 'standard', id: 'fake', axes: [0, 0, x, y], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }; navigator.getGamepads = () => [pad]; }; stick(0, 0)

steps.caption: The fight's own angle, the stick at rest
Stick right: the camera swings round to the right
Stick left: round to the left
Stick up: the camera drops and looks further up the stands
Let go: it eases back to the fight's own angle
